formula: Vsw = smooth_slew( gain * nonlinear(recent, shifted_rotation27, sigmoid_HSS, CME_pulse) + offset )

coefficients.note: Nonlinear sigmoid HSS/CIR model + 27-day phase fitting + smooth/slew limiter + observed-wind calibration.
notes: Enhanced = background + Earth-directed DONKI CME pulse.
NOAA RTSW observed solar wind is used for verification and coefficient tuning.
